titulo_es: Follow a story with time references

svuotare.consejo: Regular verb of the first conjugation.

texto: Elisa discovers during the eviction of the family home an old letter never sent. The missive reveals an unfulfilled promise of its grandmother linked to labor emigration to Genoa many years ago.
Look at the temporal links and the justification that pushes the protagonist to locate the original destination.

filas: La nonna lasciò il paese per lavorare a Genova.
Reason for the original departure and separation of the friend.
La nonna si sposò e non tornò più al paese.
Elisa trova la lettera nel cassetto con un indirizzo leggibile.
Hallazgo imprevisto mientras ordenaba la vivienda.
Elisa decide cercare la destinataria durante le vacanze.
Search driven after asking your mother for permission.

frases.it: Mentre svuotava la casa della nonna, Elisa trovò una lettera mai spedita. Era indirizzata a una donna che nessuno in famiglia conosceva.
frases.es: Mientras vaciaba la casa de la abuela, Elisa encontró una carta nunca enviada. Estaba dirigida a una mujer que nadie en la familia conocía.
frases.en: While emptying Grandma's house, Elisa found a letter never sent. It was addressed to a woman that no one in the family knew.
analisis: that no one in the family knew

frases.it: La nonna raccontava che, molti anni prima, aveva lasciato il paese per lavorare a Genova e aveva promesso di scrivere a un'amica.
frases.es: La abuela contaba que, muchos años antes, había dejado el pueblo para trabajar en Génova y había prometido escribir a una amiga.
frases.en: The grandmother said that, many years before, she had left the town to work in Genoa and had promised to write to a friend.

frases.it: Poi la vita era cambiata: si era sposata, aveva avuto figli e non era più tornata. Elisa non capiva perché la lettera fosse rimasta nel cassetto.
frases.es: Luego la vida había cambiado: se había casado, había tenido hijos y no había vuelto más. Elisa no entendía por qué la carta se había quedado en el cajón.
frases.en: Then life had changed: he had married, had had children, and had not returned. Elisa didn't understand why the letter had been left in the drawer.
analisis: would have stayed in the drawer.

frases.it: Sul retro c'era un indirizzo ancora leggibile. Dopo aver chiesto il permesso a sua madre, decise di cercare la destinataria durante le vacanze estive.
frases.es: En el reverso había una dirección todavía legible. Tras haber pedido permiso a su madre, decidió buscar a la destinataria durante las vacaciones de verano.
frases.en: On the back there was a direction still legible. After having asked his mother for permission, she decided to search for the destination during the summer break.

bloques.pregunta: What unexpected object did Elisa find while emptying her grandmother's house?

opciones.texto: An old letter written but never sent by mail.
opciones.explicacion: The text indicates that he found «una lettera mai spedita» stored in a drawer.

opciones.texto: An intimate travel diary full of family photographs.
opciones.explicacion: It does not match the documented epistolar finding.

opciones.texto: A contract of employment signed in the port city of Genoa.
opciones.explicacion: It combines the work motive of the departure with the discovered object.

bloques.pregunta: Which person was the letter found addressed to?

opciones.texto: To a woman that no member of Elisa's family knew.
opciones.explicacion: It is specified that «nessuno in famiglia conosceva» to the destination.

opciones.texto: To Elisa's mother when she was still a little girl.
opciones.explicacion: The target was a friend of the grandmother's youth, who was outside the family.

opciones.texto: To a former co-worker at the local town hall.
opciones.explicacion: It completely distinguishes the identity of the destination.

bloques.pregunta: What was the reason why Grandma had originally left her hometown?

opciones.texto: To move to work in Genoa many years ago.
opciones.explicacion: The explicit text: «aveva lasciato il paese per lavorare a Genova».

opciones.texto: To marry a merchant in the capital.
opciones.explicacion: The marriage later occurred, it was not the reason for departure.

opciones.texto: To study a college career with your friend.
opciones.explicacion: Historical and contextual inaccuracy against the narratives.

bloques.pregunta: What vital circumstance prevented Grandma from keeping the epistolar contact promised?

opciones.texto: He formed his own family with children and did not reside in his home town.
opciones.explicacion: «Si era sposata, aveva avuto figli e non era più tornata».

opciones.texto: He lost his sight and memory shortly after he was thirty.
opciones.explicacion: Unfounded extrapolation not supported by fragment.

opciones.texto: He changed the country of residence by losing all the old luggage.
opciones.explicacion: The story doesn't place Grandma abroad.

bloques.pregunta: What crucial data did the envelope maintain that facilitated a possible location?

opciones.texto: A still perfectly decipherable postal address on the back of the document.
opciones.explicacion: «Sul retro c'era un indirizzo ancora leggibile».

opciones.texto: The private phone number and the letterhead of a public office.
opciones.explicacion: At the time of writing, such telephone data were not recorded.

opciones.texto: A notation with the full name of all legal heirs.
opciones.explicacion: False: only the address of destination was included.

bloques.frase: Dopo aver chiesto il permesso a sua madre, decise di cercare la destinataria durante le vacanze estive.

opciones.texto: Tras obtener la conformidad materna, resolvió indagar el paradero de la destinataria en verano.
opciones.explicacion: A faithful reflection of the temporal subordinate and the final determination.

opciones.texto: He decided to keep the envelope in the municipal file without warning his relatives.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the fact that you consult your mother and undertake the search.

opciones.texto: He refused to travel during his vacation to forget the family mystery.
opciones.explicacion: It diametrically inverts the decision taken by the protagonist.

bloques.frase: Sul retro della lettera c'era un ___ ancora leggibile.

opciones.texto: indirizzo
opciones.explicacion: The text indicates: «Sul retro c'era un indirizzo ancora leggibile».

opciones.texto: orologio
opciones.explicacion: Substance other than correspondence («watch»).

opciones.texto: biglietto
opciones.explicacion: It means «ticket» or «note», but the account expressly mentions the direction.

intro: Read this story with attention to the chronology of events, family ties and decisions that motivate the search for a sender from the past.
